game.title: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

lede: Buffalo Bills carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play), while New England Patriots owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#8 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Buffalo Bills -7.2 with a fair total of 46.0, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Buffalo Bills pass offence vs New England Patriots pass defence, which sits +0.105 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
